_note: Phase 2 draft. Type of a source or claim. A working link is not evidence of accuracy, maintenance, interoperability or industrial suitability.

items.label: Official publisher documentation
items.summary: Pages, repositories or documents published by the resource's own publisher or maintainer.

items.label: Published standard or specification
items.summary: A formally published standard or specification (catalogue entry or text).

items.label: Peer-reviewed research
items.summary: Article or paper published after peer review.

items.label: Public project documentation
items.summary: Public outputs of a research or industrial project (for example CORDIS pages or deliverables).

items.label: Independent verification
items.summary: A third party that has independently tested or reviewed the claim.

items.label: Vendor-reported claim
items.summary: A claim made by a company about its own product or results, without independent replication.

items.label: Other third-party source
items.summary: Secondary sources such as registries, reseller pages or news. Used only as supporting context.

items.label: Editorial interpretation
items.summary: Statements written by atlas editors. Attributable and reviewable, but not a fact from a source.

items.label: Not yet classified
items.summary: Migration placeholder for sources whose type has not been reviewed.
